tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// spyir sgom chos rje rang byung rin po che'i zin thun bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// spyir sgom nyams su len pa la gnyis te/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pas so// thun mong ni sgom la theg pa chung ngu dang chen po'o// chung ngu la yang gnyis ste/ 'jig rten kyi lam sgom pa dang*/ 'jig rten 'das 'gro'i lam sgom pa'o// dang po la 'dod khams kyis 'dod chags kyi gnyen por mi sdug pa sgom pa dang*/ zhe sdang gi gnyen pos byams pa sgom pa dang*/ gti mug gi gnyen por rten 'brel dang*/ nga rgyal kyi gnyen por phung po dang khams rnam par dbye ba dang*/ rnam rtog mang ba'i gnyen por rlung dbyung ba dang*/ rngub pa'i rjes dran sgom pa ste lnga dang*/ gzugs khams kyi bsam gtan dang po dang*/ gnyis pa dang*/ gsum pa dang*/ bzhi pa zhi rags kyi rnam pa sgom pas gong ma/ gong ma'i yan lag sngon du byed cing*/ nyon mongs pa kun ldang mgo non pa dang*/ snang ba dang thogs pa dang*/ rnon kyi gnyen por nam mkha' mtha' yas dang*/ rnam shes mtha' yas dang*/ ci yang med pa dang*/ 'du shes med 'du shes med min ste/ gzugs med kyi ting nge 'dzin bzhi sgom pa dang*/ bsam gtan gsum pa sgom pas bzhi pa sgoms pa dang dus lta bu/ 'du shes dang tshor ba 'gog pa sgom pas 'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug ces bya/ 'jig rten pa'i 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug de/ 'dir rnams 'jig rten pa'i lam gyi 'gro ba ste/ 'dir ma 'dus pa med cing*/ lhag pa yang med de shes rab kyis ma zin na/ slar yang 'dog pas phyi rol pa dang yang thun mong yin no// gnyis pa 'jig rten 'das 'gro ni/ sangs rgyas kyi shes rab la bsten nas/ 'du byas pa thams cad ni mi rtag pa dang*/ sdug bsngal ba dang*/ chos thams cad bdag med pas stong pa dang*/ de mya ngan las 'das zhi bar shes pa dang*/ lam byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos/ sgrub pa ste/ shes par bya ba dang spang bar bya ba dang sngon du bya ba dang*/

sgom par bya bar shes nas/ gong gi rnams nyams su blangs pas/ nges par go cha dang*/ 'jug pa ni/ tshogs dang sbyor ba'i lam mo// 'dod pa'i khams kyi nyon mongs pa spangs pas/ mthong ba'i lam mo// bsam gtan bzhi dang gzugs med bzhi yi nyon mongs pa spang ba ni/ sgom pa'i lam mo// srid pa'i rtse mos las gyen du skyod pa'i 'du shes tshor ba 'gog pa thob pa ni/ 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug 'jig rten las 'das pa'o// 'di nas mthar phyin pa'i lam mo// rnam thar gsum dang mngon shes lnga dang*/ zad par dang zil kyi nan pa ma 'grubs na/ dgra bcom pa rgyan med pa'o// 'dir rnams dang mthar gnas dgu'i phyogs dang thod rgal kyi sdom 'jug cig rigs pa dang ldan pa'i dgra bcom pa ni rgyan dang bcas pa'o// mthar thug kyang phung po'i zag bcas lhag ma yod pas/ lhag ma dang bcas pas so// de spangs nas lhag med de/ myang 'das su song ba zhes bya'o// lam 'di yi steng du sems can mang rab kyi don byed pa'i snying rjes skal pa sum cu dang*/ lnga bcu dang*/ brgyar rgyan rnams sgom zhing*/ sangs rgyas mchod pa dang*/ chos nyan pa dang*/ gzhan la phan par byas ste/ sangs rgyas mi bzhugs pa'i zhing du/ rang gis byang chub thob par byed cing ngag gis chos mi ston par zhi bar 'jug pa rang sangs rgyas zhes bya te/ tshogs spyod chen po dang chung ngu dang*/ bse ru lta bu zhes bya ba rnams su gyur pa de theg chung gi tshul rnams so// thun mong du gsungs pa'i theg pa chen po'i lam sgom tshul ni/ khams gsum kyi sems can rnams pha mar shes shing*/ tshad med pa bzhi la bsten pa'i snying rje rgya nyi shu sgom pas smon pa dang 'jug pa'i sems bskyed cing*/ pha rol du phyin pa drug po sbyin pa dang*/ tshul khrims rgya chen por spyod pa dang*/ bzod pa dang brtson 'grus rgya che bas grogs byed cing*/ theg chung ba dang mthun pa'i bsam gtan rnams sgom pa dang shes rab gyis shes bya'i don rang gi mtshan nyid ma 'dres pa dang*/

byed pa med pa dang*/ rang bzhin ming dang ma 'brel ba dang*/ ming la don med pa dang*/ don la ming med pa dang*/ don la bsten nas ming 'dags pa dang*/ ming la bsten nas don la 'jug pa dang chos gang yang mi 'pho/ mi skye mi 'gag ci yang sten cing 'brel ste 'byung bar mthong bas/ chad pa dang rtag par mthong ba dang*/ 'gro 'ong song mi dmigs pa 'di ltar spyod pas/ nyon mongs pa rnams sel cing*/ 'khor bar skyo ba med pa'i go cha dang*/ 'jug pa sgrub pa ni tshogs dang sbyor ba'o// sems sa bon thams cad pa la/ nyon mongs pa'i chos dang gang zag ma 'brel ba/ mngon sum du mthong ba ni mthong lam mo// rnam par mi rtog pa'i shes rab de dang*/ bsam gtan bzhi pa la bsten nas/ zad par dang zil gyis gnon pa dang*/ thar gyi gnas pa dang*/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum dang thod sgal gyi snyoms 'jug dang*/ ting nge 'dzin rnams sbyong zhing*/ mos pa dang*/ bsngo ba dang*/ rjes su yid rang ba'i thabs mkhas pas mthu rdzogs par byed pas/ nyon sgrib lhag ma dang*/ shes bya la sgrib pa sbyong ba ni sgom lam sa drug dang*/ rnam par mi rtog pa dang*/ gzungs dang so so yang dag par rig pa dang*/ ye shes dang byang chub kyi snying po'i rgyan sbyong ba dag pa sa gsum ste sgom lam mo// rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis sgrib pa lhag ma ma rig pa'i bag chags kyi spong zhing*/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur ba ni mthar phyin pa'i lam ste/ skal pa grangs med pa gsum gyis sangs rgyas pa zhes bya'o// thun mong ma yin pa'i sems sgom pa'i tshul la gnyis ste/ don dang thabs so// dang po ni shes bya'i gzhi dri ma med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi snying po spros pa thams cad dang bral bas/ gdod ma nas zhi ba dang*/ lus dang sems la sangs rgyas kyi yon tan drug cu rtsa bzhi ma tshang ba med par yid chos/ ji lta ba dang*/ ji snyed pa yongs su grub par rtogs shing*/

de la yul dang yul can tha dad du snang ba'i zhing dang don ma rtogs pa'i 'du byed pa las ming dang don la mtshan mar 'dzin pa 'byung pas/ gzhan dbang dang kun gtags/ sa bon thams cad pa'i kun gzhi rnam par shes pa dri ma glo bur bar mthong nas chos lnga dang*/ rang bzhin gsum dang*/ rnam par shes pa brgyad kyi bsang ba nges par rtog cing*/ bden pa gnyis kyi rang bzhin shes par byed pa 'di las/ gzhi shes pa dang*/ lam shes pa dang*/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid blang dor kyi tshul shes pa ni rgyu dang*/ de'i sbyor ba la 'jug pa dang*/ rtse mo dang mthar gyis sgom pa dang*/ skad cig ma'i skabs kyi lam sgom pa'i tshul la 'jug cing*/ mthar thug pa dri ma thams cad dang bral ba'i 'bras bu mdzad pa 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i khams thob par gyur pa la/ dmigs pa dang rnam pa tshad med pa'i tshul gyis sgoms par byed pa'o// thabs ni yul kyi gnad dang rtsa dang*/ rlung dang*/ thig le dang*/ rnam par rtog pa re re la'ang*/ dbang cha dang gnyen po'i tshul shes nas bsam gyis mi khyab pa shes pa'i rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa dang*/ theg pa'i tshul so so la mos sems 'dzin pa'i zhi gnas dang*/ rang rang gi tshul rjes su dran pa'i don sgom pas ste/ 'di shes na sangs rgyas kyi rdzu 'phrul kyi grol gyis 'gro ba'i lam zhes byas ste bsam gyis mi khyab bo// rtogs pa'i lhag mthong ni kun tu 'gro ba nyid do// nyams su blangs tshul kyi don bsdus pa 'di/ 'gro ba'i shes rab snang bar byed pa dang*/ bsam gyis mi khyab don la 'jug phyir bris/ sems can thams cad ye shes sku thob shog /ces pa 'di ni chos kyi rje rang byung rdo rje'i yis lugs lo zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bcu gsum la ri khrod bde chen du mdzad pa'o// bkra shi dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /zhus so// dge'o// /bkra shis// // /
